snippet.title: Doo-Daa Trailer
snippet.description:
Doo-Daa is my Senior Thesis for my BFA in Game Arts at Pratt Institute, which will be published as a full game in May 2026, with music from Miles Pride and Benny Brewer!

Miles Pride's Music for Doo-Daa at https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjUpHFuiKcS7dZMhyGpHWeE_7J5527FlM

You can follow the development at https://bobby4apples.itch.io/doo-daa!

Trailer Music: string classic - 4:4:25, 4.51 AM by VADE is licensed under a Attribution 4.0 International License. From Free Music Archive.
